before: A view-only content-control tag glued to the word beside it, so a chain of tags and text with no space between them made one unit, and a unit wider than the line stood past the margin.
after: A line can open before an open tag and after a close tag, nested tags and line-bound punctuation stay together, and a tag too wide for its line keeps its start and ends in an ellipsis.
reason: Tags are layout-owned view chrome over a zero-width model range. Only where lines break and what a tag paints change; no operation, field or shared update format changes, and a peer lays out the same document unchanged.
